contract: A23-39 server: Config.IsTamer(class, faction) = Neutral + Archer. Config.Classes.Archer.Names.Neutral = '펫 조련사'; Config.WeaponName = Config.WeaponNames.Tamer (조련 지휘봉 줄) and WeaponArtKey 'Weapon_Tamer_T1..6' for the tamer (T7 / T8 keep the Archer keys); Config.AttackProfile(Archer, tier, Neutral) = the Archer row (armed) or the punch (bare) with Style 'PetHeadbutt'; Config.ClassCard = Config.Tamer.Card. CombatService: Swing Fx Style PetHeadbutt (contact 0.3, no launch / flight), Release Fx Style 'PetDash' (contact 0.35), damage = a Halo archer's. PetService: data.Pets { List[uid] = { Sp, Lv, XP, Name, Lean, Bound }, Equipped = { uid }, Next } sanitized at join; attributes EquippedPet / PetLv / PetForm; a tamer (class pick, class change, faction change or a join) gets the baby slime once, equipped, Bound, with Text.PetGot; a save that was the artisan hunter before (no TamerNotice) gets Text.Became + one free Class ticket once; a tamer made during a session sets TamerNotice without a ticket. CharacterVisuals: the tamer holds a baton.
limitations: Offline doubles as tools/test_unarmed_start.py. The pet following its owner, the headbutt / dash animations, the class card and the bag pet row are the 게임성 개발 1 contract; real play after the merge.
